Class DeterministicPRNG

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.util.DeterministicPRNG
public final class DeterministicPRNG extends Object
High-Performance Lock-Free Deterministic Pseudo-Random Number Generator. Based on 64-bit SplitMix64 non-linear bit mixing algorithm. Eliminates thread contention, CAS locks, and state sharing while guaranteeing 100% bitwise deterministic reproducibility across concurrent threads.
Version:
4.0.0
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
